_about: Check-in DMs for quiet members (GreMi 2026-10-14), run by bot/checkin.py and read live. 'on': false stops sending; the buttons keep working. {name} is the member's server name.
text: Hey {name}! I'm **Race Control**, the bot of GreMi's Discord. We haven't heard from you in a while, so I came to check in. 👀

Quick reminder: GreMi is a sim racer who streams EA F1 and Le Mans Ultimate on Twitch, YouTube and TikTok. He races with the community in open lobbies, so you can jump in and race him live, or just hang out in chat and talk racing.
Still up for being part of the gang? No hard feelings either way.
